fixed_transition_model.name: FIXED_POINT_LOGIC_WITH_COUNTING_GLOBAL_IMPLICIT_MODEL
fixed_transition_model.input_model: unordered finite relational encoding of 3-CNF/CSP instances
fixed_transition_model.semantics: One fixed FPC interpretation/sentence, with inflationary/least fixed-point recursion and counting, supplies the global invariant/decision update without an externally supplied total order or arbitrary symmetry-breaking choice.
why_distinct_from_prior_routes: not bounded-local Datalog only: FPC has fixed-point recursion plus counting

published_basis.title: Affine systems of equations and counting infinitary logic
published_basis.statement_used: Solvability of systems of equations over a finite Abelian group is not definable in infinitary logic with finitely many variables and counting, hence not in fixed-point logic with counting; the paper develops reductions transferring such inexpressibility to CSPs with the relevant algebraic types.

published_basis.author: Anuj Dawar
published_basis.title: The Nature and Power of Fixed-Point Logic with Counting
published_basis.statement_used: The survey explicitly records that, via the Atserias-Bulatov-Dawar line and first-order reductions, 3-SAT is among the CSPs not definable in FPC.

derived_TRUMP_barrier.claim: A TRUMP route whose complete arbitrary-3CNF decision semantics are captured by one fixed FPC program on the unordered relational encoding cannot discharge universal exact 3SAT decision.
reason: FPC computations are global fixed-point/counting computations rather than bounded-local clause propagation.
Nevertheless 3-SAT is not definable in FPC in the standard unordered relational setting.
Therefore globality, recursion and counting still do not by themselves supply a universal exact transition law within this fixed model.
derived_TRUMP_barrier.scope: This is an unconditional inexpressibility result for FPC, not a lower bound for all deterministic polynomial-time algorithms.

dead_zone_mapping.meaning: Indistinguishability inside a chosen representation/logic is an information dead zone of that model, not evidence that the underlying SAT statuses coincide.

what_is_not_proved: No claim is made that every polynomial-time algorithm is expressible in FPC.
No claim is made that adding an external canonical order or stronger choice mechanism preserves this barrier without separate proof.
No claim is made that FPC inexpressibility implies P!=NP.
No claim is made that every individual 3-CNF pair is indistinguishable in FPC.

next_admissible_math.question: Can a successor global exact route escape FPC by a precisely specified extra resource (for example canonical ordering/choice, algebraic operator, or another implicit invariant) and still prove total polynomial construction and update cost for arbitrary 3CNF?
forbidden: assuming a canonical order without proving polynomial construction
treating model indistinguishability as SAT equivalence
